basics.title: HR Assistant
basics.tagline: Reliable, concrete, and team-oriented daily HR management
basics.summary: Driven by the desire to place people at the heart of the company, I offer a comprehensive HR approach, supported by my mastery of labor law and my great adaptability. My goal is to commit to your side under a permanent contract to support your development, by providing daily HR management that is reliable, concrete, and attentive to the teams.

skillGroups.title: Reporting & Analysis
items: Creation and tracking of HR indicators

bullets: Complete administrative management of training actions: planning, monitoring, and updating files.
Management and coordination of apprenticeships and internships, from onboarding to administrative monitoring.
Participation in the operational management of HR activities in line with the company's strategy.
Implementation and management of digital archiving of training certificates and documents.
Rigorous monitoring of staff leave, absences, and attendance, in liaison with the manager.
Creation, analysis, and monitoring of HR indicators for reporting and decision support.
Collection, entry, and verification of variable pay elements (hours, absences, bonuses, leave).
Processing of individual requests relating to remuneration and social benefits.
Monthly collection, entry, and verification of Variable Pay Elements (EVP).
Monitoring of working hours and processing of absences (paid leave, RTT, sick leave).
Management of onboarding formalities: hiring declarations (DPAE) and affiliations (mutual insurance, provident fund).
Welcoming and responding to customers by phone, email, and messaging.
Providing clear and precise information on products and services.
Managing and quickly resolving customer complaints.
Monitoring customer files and updating databases.
Coordinating with internal teams to handle complex requests.
Meeting performance objectives and quality standards.

education.degree: Bachelor in Management Applied to Human and Social Sciences
